## Day 3 (4 Feb):

Planned: Drive from Furano to Otaru to Sapporo

Thoughts

- Furano to Sapporo is around 2 hours
    
- Sapporo to Otaru is around 1 hour by car, but 35 mins by train
    
- Probably best to drive to Sapporo, park the car, then take a train to Otaru and back
